(2) task/tests/tools/score.py:41 gates_passed requires every gate score > 0.0; :43-44 force every weighted dimension to 0.0 unless gates passed and scored data exists; :46 computes the weighted mean over [weights] keys only, so gate scores never enter the reward; :47-48 reward is 0.0 unless gates_passed and functional > 0.05; :83 returns 1 on gate failure. (3) task/tests/test.sh:212-222 removes any stale scored directory, runs the gates suite first, calls score.py, and on status 1 exits before line 224 ever launches the scored suite; other non-zero statuses rewrite the zero reward; scored runs at :224 and score.py again at :227. (4) Gate judges use aggregation all_pass with binary criteria (gates/render/judge.toml:14-21; gates/constraints/judge.toml:14-30), so each gate dimension is 0 or 1; the per-criterion weight = 1.0 there is template-identical and has no effect on reward mass. (5) scoring.toml, score.py, test.sh and restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the frozen template (sha256 95f70d6e..., 13de2b38..., bd682592..., 03c1426f... on both sides), so no task-side change to reward policy. Executed evidence (score.py and scoring.toml copied to the session scratch directory, synthetic RewardKit JSON inputs, nothing written in .qc-cache): render=0 with perfect scored data -> reward 0.0, exit 1; constraints=0 with perfect scored data -> reward 0.0, exit 1; both gates passed and no scored suite -> reward 0.0 (gates alone earn nothing); gates passed, functional 0.0, polish 1, visual 1 -> reward 0.0 (weighted_score 0.4 discarded, floors_passed 0); functional exactly 0.05 with polish 1, visual 1 -> reward 0.0 (strict >); functional 0.0531 -> reward 0.4319; functional 1 only -> 0.6; all 1 -> 1.0. Weak-app probe: functional has 40 binary criteria with total weight 56.5, so the floor needs more than 2.825 weight, i.e. at least two 1.5-weight criteria or three 1.0-weight ones; a static shell or mock cannot reach the scored suite at all because the gates need real typing plus computed Run output (render) and a non-form-field editor surface plus a save that survives cleared browser storage (constraints), and polish/visual prompts line 5 repeat an in-dimension gate. Conforming-alternative probe: a correct app with a canvas or SVG editor and a hidden input for key events is explicitly allowed by gates/constraints/judge.toml:23, so the gate arrangement does not zero a conforming design. Limits: this is source inspection plus an isolated run of score.py on synthetic inputs.
